description: One metric per resource family for the fleet dots on the Bridge. The head first asks count by (resource_urn) ({resource_urn=~"..."}) with no metric name; if Insights rejects that, it switches to these metrics, one query per family and region. verified true means the name is in the region catalog (watcher/catalog, from label/__name__/values); scripts/check_metric_names.py fails CI on a name that is not, and the head logs a warning at startup.
